title: Research Question Generator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Develops questions suitable for academic investigation. The Research Question Generator develops questions suitable for academic investigation. It takes a broad topic and produces specific, researchable questions: narrowed in scope, answerable with evidence, and matched to the student's level and the assignment. Each question comes with a note on what kind of evidence would answer it.
capabilities: Narrow broad topics into specific questions
Ensure questions are answerable with evidence
Match questions to student level and assignment
Suggest what evidence would answer each
Offer several angles on the same topic
